summary: Bank of Marin Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results and a quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share, payable May 14, 2026. The filing includes a press release and earnings presentation furnished under Items 2.02, 7.01, and 8.01. There is no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special situation. This is a routine periodic earnings and dividend announcement, not a special-situation event.
